# GENERATED by tools/ghidra/demo_export_maps.java.
# Named data globals - everything outside .text that has
# a name somebody chose. DATA, not a document.
#
#   ADDRESS,NAME,TYPE,COUNT,SIZE,SRC,BLOCK
#
# ADDRESS is the virtual address, 8 hex digits, no 0x.
# TYPE is undefined where no type has been applied, and
# SIZE is then 0 - an untyped global is a byte with a
# label on it, not a known object.
#
# SRC: user is a name we chose. A DOS MZ ships no
# library metadata, so there should be no sdk rows -
# one appearing means an analyser guessed a name.
#
# Ghidra's own DAT_/PTR_/s_SomeString_001c4000 labels are
# excluded. A label we have not chosen is not knowledge.
#
# Enum constants are NOT here - they live with their enum
# in struct_map.txt, which is their one home.
